interactive=true fork=true denyAsk=true.notice: python and python3 are refused in every lym session, a version check included, so never probe for Python: what it runs differs from machine to machine with the installed packages, venvs and installations, and it is often very slow; when the work itself needs Python, as OCR does, say so to the operator or your parent, who can set deny_python: false for the hub, and never work round the guard. raw module-wide, tmux-tier and llm-tier go runs are refused here. A compile check names its packages, as in go build ./internal/x or go vet ./internal/x, never ./... or all. Gate rule: run lym gate test in the foreground with the Bash tool timeout set to 3600000, never in the background, for example lym gate test ./internal/x, and use its --tier flag for a tier. When lym gate test or lym gate card-verify answers done: false, run the same command again in a turn that does nothing else, so the prompt cache stays warm between calls. Run every other check in the foreground too, and never cd into the directory you already work in. The slot, strand and prebuilt-binary environment variables belong to lym, and a command setting or reading any of them is refused. sed -i, perl -i, and a heredoc, redirect or tee into a source file are refused here; change a file by reading it with Read, whole or a span through offset and limit, and then editing it with Edit, all edits of one file in one message, or write a whole file with Write; search files with grep. rm on a computed path, one built from a variable or a command substitution, is refused here because it raises a permission prompt that stalls the run; remove a file by its literal path. the machine sleep commands are refused here; a hibernate goes through lym hibernate request, which waits until every session is paused, and a pair agent asks its parent session to run it. a headless claude launch, in print mode, is refused here because its work shows in no pane; hand the work to a subagent through the Agent tool instead, which runs inside this session and shows in its pane.
